tables.purpose: Centre-level indent quantities aggregated by center_name for the selected From/To window (filter on indent_date).
Centre-level purchase quantities aggregated by center_name for the selected From/To window (filter on purchase_date).
Defines crushing-season date windows for STD preset, compare-season chip labels, and aligned prior/season comparison ranges.
Optional legacy BI settings via GET /bi/settings; Centre Maturity compare chips use season_mapping only (thirdSeasonCompareEnabled forced off in admin save).

rows.name: Centers Evaluated
rows.description: Number of centres returned by the API for the current date window. One row per distinct center_name that has indent data in the period.
rows.formula: centers.length (frontend). Backend builds centers from indent GROUP BY rows only: combinedCenters.length.
rows.comparison: Not compared. Subtitle shows active range preset (MTD, STD, WTD, or Custom) only.

rows.name: Centers (subtitle)
rows.description: Same centre count as Centers Evaluated, shown in the dashboard subtitle next to the static SPE 26 label.
rows.formula: totalCentersCount = centers.length
rows.comparison: Not compared.

rows.name: Indent Qty (Qtl)
rows.description: Total indent quantity across all centres for the selected From/To date range.
rows.formula: SQL: SELECT SUM(indent_qty) AS total FROM centre_indent_data WHERE indent_date >= from AND indent_date <= to. API: Math.round(currIndentVal).toLocaleString('en-IN'). Null/NaN total treated as 0 via parseFloat(...) || 0.
rows.comparison: Compared when hasCompare is true. Variance (absolute Qtl): currIndentVal - prevIndentVal, rounded to 2 decimals. Change %: ((currIndentVal - prevIndentVal) / prevIndentVal) * 100 when prevIndentVal > 0, else 0 (change chip hidden). Direction normal: isUp when change >= 0. Chip label: vs {compareLabel} from API or vs Prev. Month|Season|Week|Period from frontend. Hidden when hasCompare is false or prevIndentVal is 0; shows No prior data.

rows.name: Indent Qty variance chip
rows.description: Absolute difference in total indent between current and comparison windows, prefixed with + or - in the KPI chip.
rows.formula: indentVariance = hasCompare ? currIndentVal - prevIndentVal : 0; API parseFloat(indentVariance.toFixed(2)). Display: formatVariance(v) adds sign and en-IN grouping with 0-2 fraction digits.
rows.comparison: Only shown inside change chip when hasCompare && seasonKpi.indentQty.change != null. prevIndentVal from SUM(indent_qty) WHERE indent_date BETWEEN pyFrom AND pyTo.

rows.name: Indent Qty change %
rows.description: Percent change in total indent versus the comparison window.
rows.formula: indentChangePct = prevIndentVal > 0 ? (indentVariance / prevIndentVal) * 100 : 0; displayed as Number(change).toFixed(2) inside parentheses in chip.
rows.comparison: Normal (higher is up/green). Shown only when hasCompare && prevIndentVal > 0.

rows.name: Purchase Qty (Qtl)
rows.description: Total purchase quantity across all centres for the selected From/To date range.
rows.formula: SQL: SELECT SUM(purchase_qty) AS total FROM centre_purchase_data WHERE purchase_date >= from AND purchase_date <= to. API: Math.round(currPurchaseVal).toLocaleString('en-IN'). Null/NaN treated as 0.
rows.comparison: Compared when hasCompare is true. Variance: currPurchaseVal - prevPurchaseVal (2 dp). Change %: ((curr - prev) / prev) * 100 when prevPurchaseVal > 0. Normal direction. Same compare label pattern as Indent. Hidden when hasCompare false or prevPurchaseVal is 0.

rows.name: Purchase Qty variance chip
rows.description: Absolute difference in total purchase between current and comparison windows in the KPI chip.
rows.formula: purchaseVariance = hasCompare ? currPurchaseVal - prevPurchaseVal : 0; parseFloat(purchaseVariance.toFixed(2)); formatVariance for display.
rows.comparison: Shown when hasCompare && seasonKpi.purchaseQty.change != null.

rows.name: Purchase Qty change %
rows.description: Percent change in total purchase versus the comparison window.
rows.formula: purchaseChangePct = prevPurchaseVal > 0 ? (purchaseVariance / prevPurchaseVal) * 100 : 0; Number(change).toFixed(2) in chip.
rows.comparison: Normal direction. Shown only when hasCompare && prevPurchaseVal > 0.

rows.name: Maturity %
rows.description: Portfolio-level maturity: total purchase divided by total indent for the date window, expressed as a percentage (purchase/indent ratio x 100).
rows.formula: API: baseMaturity = currIndentVal > 0 ? (currPurchaseVal / currIndentVal) * 100 : 0; parseFloat(baseMaturity.toFixed(2)). Frontend display: (seasonKpi.maturity.value != null ? seasonKpi.maturity.value : grandAvgMaturity * 100).toFixed(2) + '%'. grandAvgMaturity fallback = SUM(center.purchase) / SUM(center.indent) from API centers array when API value null.
rows.comparison: Compared when hasCompare. compMaturity = prevIndentVal > 0 ? (prevPurchaseVal / prevIndentVal) * 100 : 0. Variance in percentage points: baseMaturity - compMaturity (2 dp). Change %: (maturityVariance / compMaturity) * 100 when compMaturity > 0. Normal direction (higher maturity is up/green). Hidden when hasCompare false or compMaturity is 0.

rows.name: Maturity % variance chip
rows.description: Absolute change in portfolio maturity versus comparison, shown as a signed number before the percent change in the chip (not a ratio).
rows.formula: maturityVariance = hasCompare ? baseMaturity - compMaturity : 0; parseFloat(maturityVariance.toFixed(2)); formatVariance for sign and locale.
rows.comparison: Shown when hasCompare && seasonKpi.maturity.change != null.

rows.name: Maturity % change %
rows.description: Relative percent change of portfolio maturity versus the comparison window maturity.
rows.formula: maturityChangePct = compMaturity > 0 ? (maturityVariance / compMaturity) * 100 : 0; Number(change).toFixed(2) in chip.
rows.comparison: Normal direction. Shown only when hasCompare && compMaturity > 0.

rows.name: hasCompare
rows.description: Controls whether comparison chips appear on all three KPI cards. False shows No prior data on each card.
rows.formula: hasCompare = Boolean(pyFrom && pyTo) && (prevIndentVal > 0 || prevPurchaseVal > 0). First load without from/to returns hasCompare: false with zero placeholders.
rows.comparison: pyFrom/pyTo from query params resolved by frontend resolveCockpitCompareRange.

rows.name: MTD From/To
rows.description: Month-to-date window: first day of the month containing the reference To date through the reference To date.
rows.formula: getCockpitPresetDateRange('MTD', ref): from = formatYMD(new Date(year, month, 1)), to = formatYMD(ref). ref = resolveDashboardToDate(null, dbMaxDateStr) clamped to data bounds.
rows.source: centre_indent_data.indent_date (dbMaxDateStr from MIN/MAX query on load)
rows.comparison: Default PP compare label: Prev. Month via computePriorPeriodRange (shift month -1 with end-of-month clamp).

rows.name: STD From/To
rows.description: Season-to-date window: season_mapping start_date for the season containing To through To. Fallback Oct 1 of crushing year if no mapping.
rows.formula: label = findSeasonLabelForDate(to, seasonMapping); from = seasonMapping[label].startDate OR formatYMD(new Date(seasonStartYear, 9, 1)) where seasonStartYear = month>=9 ? year : year-1.
rows.comparison: Default PP compare: alignMappedSeasonByDayOffset(from, to, labels.season1, seasonMapping) with label Prev. Season when mapping exists.

rows.name: WTD From/To
rows.description: Week-to-date window: Monday of the week containing To through To (Monday-start week).
rows.formula: from = formatYMD(startOfWeekMonday(ref)), to = formatYMD(ref). startOfWeekMonday: offset = day===0 ? 6 : day-1; subtract offset days.
rows.source: N/A (calendar math; To clamped to centre_indent_data max date)
rows.comparison: Default PP compare label: Prev. Week (dates shifted -7 days).

rows.name: Custom From/To
rows.description: User-selected inclusive date range, passed as from and to query params to the API.
rows.formula: Manual date inputs; clampToData(iso) enforces dbMinDateStr <= iso <= dbMaxDateStr.
rows.comparison: Default PP compare: equal-length window ending day before current From via computePriorPeriodRange Custom branch.

rows.name: Prev. Period (PP) compare window
rows.description: Prior-period comparison aligned to the active range preset. Sent as pyFrom/pyTo query params.
rows.formula: resolveCockpitCompareRange(..., 'PP'): if STD && seasonMapping non-empty then alignMappedSeasonByDayOffset(from, to, seasonLabels.season1, seasonMapping) else computePriorPeriodRange(from, to, rangePreset). Labels: MTD=Prev. Month, STD=Prev. Season, WTD=Prev. Week, Custom=Prev. Period.
rows.comparison: Chip label from getCockpitPPLabel(rangePreset). KPI subtitle: vs {label}.

rows.name: Season compare chips
rows.description: One button per season_mapping row except the season containing the reference To date, sorted newest start_date first. Selecting a chip compares against that season label.
rows.formula: buildCockpitComparisonOptions: listCompareSeasonsFromMapping(refIso, seasonMapping) filters out current season; id = 'SEASON:' + season_label; label = season_label. Fallback if no mapping: calendar labels getSeasonComparisonLabels (y-2/y-1, y-3/y-2, y-4/y-3).
rows.comparison: resolveCockpitCompareRange for SEASON: label: STD uses alignMappedSeasonByDayOffset; MTD/WTD/Custom use alignMappedSeasonCompareRange (calendar month/day mapped into target season bounds, clamped to start_date/end_date). KPI subtitle: vs {season_label}.

rows.name: KPI comparison subtitle
rows.description: Text beside the change chip on each KPI card identifying the comparison baseline.
rows.formula: seasonKpi.compareLabel ? 'vs ' + seasonKpi.compareLabel : compareBadgeLabel where compareBadgeLabel = cmp.label ? 'vs ' + cmp.label : 'vs Prev. Period'. API compareLabel = query compareLabel OR pyFrom + ' - ' + pyTo.
rows.comparison: Reflects active PP or season chip selection.

rows.name: Section number
rows.description: Static section index for each of the four side-by-side table columns (1 through 4).
rows.formula: tableIndex + 1 where tables = centers split into 4 chunks of ceil(length/4) rows each.
rows.comparison: Not compared.

rows.name: Centers count (per section)
rows.description: Number of centre rows shown in that table section after search filter.
rows.formula: filtered.length where filtered = data.filter(center name contains searchQuery case-insensitive). data is one quarter slice of sorted centers array.
rows.comparison: Not compared.

rows.name: Indent
rows.description: Per-centre indent quantity for the selected date window. Centres appear only if they have indent rows in the period.
rows.formula: SQL per center: SUM(indent_qty) GROUP BY center_name WHERE indent_date >= from AND indent_date <= to. API: Math.round(parseFloat(indent_qty) || 0). Display: row.indent.toLocaleString('en-IN').
rows.comparison: Not compared at row level.

rows.name: Maturity
rows.description: Per-centre maturity: purchase quantity divided by indent quantity for that centre in the window.
rows.formula: API: maturity = indentQty > 0 ? purchaseQty / indentQty : 0 (ratio 0-1, stored parseFloat(toFixed(4))). purchaseQty from SUM(purchase_qty) GROUP BY center_name WHERE purchase_date in range; 0 if centre missing from purchase map. Display: (row.maturity * 100).toFixed(1) + '%'.
rows.source: centre_indent_data.indent_qty, centre_indent_data.indent_date, centre_purchase_data.purchase_qty, centre_purchase_data.purchase_date, centre_indent_data.center_name, centre_purchase_data.center_name
rows.comparison: Not compared at row level. Row sort order: maturity DESC, then center ASC (determines table placement and top-10 rank).

rows.name: Top 10 rank badge
rows.description: Award badge showing global rank 1-10 by maturity among visible centres (search-filtered). Shown only for ranks 1 through 10.
rows.formula: globalTopRankMap: sort centers (or search-filtered subset) by (b.maturity || 0) - (a.maturity || 0), take first 10, assign rank idx+1. TopTenBadge renders only if rank && rank <= 10.
rows.comparison: Not compared.

rows.name: Total Indent
rows.description: Sum of indent values for all centres in that table section after search filter.
rows.formula: totalIndent = filtered.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.indent || 0), 0); toLocaleString('en-IN').
rows.comparison: Not compared.

rows.name: Avg Maturity
rows.description: Section-level weighted average maturity: sum of purchase over sum of indent for centres in that section (not an arithmetic mean of row percentages).
rows.formula: totalPurchase = filtered.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.purchase || 0), 0); avgMaturity = totalIndent === 0 ? 0 : totalPurchase / totalIndent; display (avgMaturity * 100).toFixed(1) + '%'. Note: purchase is API field, not shown as its own column.
rows.comparison: Not compared.

rows.name: Centre row order
rows.description: Determines which centres appear in which section and their vertical order within each table.
rows.formula: combinedCenters.sort((a,b) => b.maturity - a.maturity || a.center.localeCompare(b.center)); split into 4 arrays of ceil(n/4) elements.
rows.comparison: Not compared.

rows.name: Center name search
rows.description: Client-side filter on centre name; affects visible rows, per-section counts, footer totals, and top-10 rank map.
rows.formula: r.center.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
rows.comparison: Not compared.

rows.name: Data min/max dates
rows.description: Not rendered as a visible number on the dashboard; used to clamp date pickers and seed STD range on first load.
rows.formula: SQL: SELECT MIN(indent_date) AS minDate, MAX(indent_date) AS maxDate FROM centre_indent_data. Returned in dateRange object.
rows.comparison: Not compared.

rows.name: availableSeasons
rows.description: Season labels from season_mapping returned in API meta; drives compare chips when merged with GET /bi/settings seasonMapping.
rows.formula: seasonsRes.map(s => s.season_label) ordered by start_date DESC in SQL.
rows.comparison: Used to build compare chip options, not displayed as a numeric value.
